title: Route chat messages through a chat room
description: In a chat room, users should not send messages directly to each other. Instead every message goes through a ChatRoom mediator that broadcasts it to all other participants. User.send() passes the message to the chat room; User.receive() is called by the chat room to deliver a message. Implement ChatRoom and complete User.send().
hints: ChatRoom keeps a list of registered User objects
broadcast() calls receive() on every user except the sender
issues: Without a mediator, every user needs a reference to every other user, creating a tangled web of dependencies
Adding a new user requires updating all existing users
overallGoal: Use the Mediator pattern so users only know about the ChatRoom, and the ChatRoom handles all routing logic.
goals: Create a ChatRoom class that holds a list of registered User objects
Add a register(User) method to ChatRoom that adds the user to its list
In sendMessage(), loop through all users and deliver the message to everyone except the sender
